subject: RE: Encord Introduction
text:
Dear Steffan,

Thanks for your update. Do we directly request permission for the video? Because we received a permission denied by Google Drive.
We will be available by next Thursday, 16:00-18:00 GTC+8.
Also, there are some questions on our discussion for the platform evaluation:

  1.  Error Label Filtering
https://encord.com/active/ Do we have access to this feature?

  1.  Project/Label Versioning
The version of the project is presented in “tags” and “ontology”. There is no specific “node and tree” recording the status of the project, right?
So if the semantics of certain labels change (for instance, I would like to label IC only with large components rather than general ICs),  the user should “add new ontology”.

  1.  Do you support “Data Browsing”?
As far as I know, Encord has published a huge dataset. Do you have a feature or service that users can request or browse public datasets, then add to the current data?

  1.  Pricing
We would like to know the general pricing or pricing mechanisms.

Thanks!

Best
Lawrence

subject: Re: Looking forward to meet
text:
Hi James,

It was a pleasure to meet you. Looking forward to seeing the demo on Tuesday at 1 pm.

A few tech questions:

  1.
Do you have lakefs or other data versioning system integration?
  2.
Is it possible to implement a data hook between Encord and the bucket?
  3.
Is it possible to add custom sources (rather than AWS S3, GCP etc)?
  4.
Where are the artifacts stored? Can we implement a hook to store them in our format?
  5.
How easy is it to link the annotation/labeling in our dataset for actual users?

21 CFR  part 11 compliance:

  1.
Do you support Part 11 (compliant vs capable)?
  2.
Audit trail for label/review/config/export changes + exportable logs?
  3.
E-signatures for approvals (re-auth/2FA)?
  4.
SSO/MFA/SCIM + RBAC (esp. external annotators)?
  5.
Do you provide a validation pack + change-control/release notice?
  6.
Can we lock/freeze a dataset version and reproduce it later?

Thanks,
-Ilya

subject: Re: Encord & Deepecho
text:
Hello Kamil,

Thank you very much for your availability and transparency. Please find
below the annotation guidelines prepared by our medical annotation lead Dr.
Noureddine and attached a file describing the labels, I will send over a
sample task shortly.

*1. to segment all anatomical structures that are visible* on each frame,
using the polygon tool on CVAT (please feel free to use the existing CVAT
options for increased efficiency, such as "Track" instead of "Shape", or
copy-paste/propagate between frames and adjust, as you see fit for maximum
efficiency).
*2. to fill in the details* on the right sidebar for relevant structures.
*3. to annotate relevant measures* when present (cf guidelines file), using:
- ellipses for head circumference and abdominal circumference,
- polyline (one point on each end of the measurement) on all other measures,
- please note that the sdp measure (single deepest pocket) is supposed to
be found maximum once per job, as its name suggests.
*4. to tag standard views*, following the guidelines criteria. A standard
view frame needs to have all green criteria and non of the red ones to be
considered a standard plane and tagged as such.
*5. to use relevant tags* for the following cases:
- obstetric ultrasound on the first frame (number 0) of each job, and
filling its details,
- "no annotation" for doppler frames/divided frames/M-mode/endovaginal
probe/3D/ and irrelevant (this latter referring to frames containing no
structure that is on the guidelines list),
- duplicate frame for duplicates.

Thanks,
Saad

*Saad Slimani M.D.*

Chief Medical Officer & Co-founder, DeepEcho
